title: Mixed Berry Protein Smoothie
seoTitle: Mixed Berry Protein Smoothie | Firefighter Smoothie
subtitle: Protein · High protein
description: Frozen berries and Greek yogurt give this one milkshake thickness without ice cream. It is the hall default when someone wants protein after a workout or before a long night.
intro: Frozen berries and Greek yogurt give this one milkshake thickness without ice cream. It is the hall default when someone wants protein after a workout or before a long night.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Mixed Berry Protein Smoothie in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on. Use vanilla extract, ice cubes as listed — measure each before heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Protein blend. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Add yogurt, milk, and
steps.instruction: Add yogurt, milk, and berries to the blender. Pulse a few times to break up frozen fruit before blending on high. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Blend 45–60 seconds until
steps.instruction: Blend 45–60 seconds until completely smooth — no berry seeds stuck to the sides. Texture should pour like thick cream, not run like juice.

steps.title: Taste once. Add honey
steps.instruction: Taste once. Add honey only if the berries were tart; frozen commercial blends are often sweet enough on their own. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Serve immediately in tall
steps.instruction: Serve immediately in tall cups, or hold in the fridge up to 4 hours — stir before drinking because separation is normal. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

substitutions: Swap Greek yogurt for skyr for even more protein per cup.
Use whey or plant protein powder (1 scoop) if you need a bigger protein bump.
shiftNote: Works when the crew wants something cold and filling between meals without firing up the stove. Cleanup is one blender jar.
proTips: Works when the crew wants something cold and filling between meals without firing up the stove. Cleanup is one blender jar.
Rinse the blender jar between batches so flavors do not muddy the next crew's cups.
If tones drop during service, cover hot food and hold at 140°F — note hold time on the pan for food safety.
tonightSpread: Pour Mixed Berry Protein Smoothie into insulated cups or quart jars on ice for grab-and-go service.
Set granola, nut butter, and extra fruit in side bowls so crew can customize without slowing the line.
Keep a backup blender batch chilled at 38°F if service runs past 20 minutes.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
